item.title: Justin Liles: A Quiet Stretch of Weather
item.description: Light snow is expected Tuesday night in the Arrowhead, but no accumulation is forecast and drier air will turn most of it into flurries. High pressure moving in from the west will bring pleasant weather to the upper Midwest for the rest of the week and likely into the weekend, with lighter winds, drier air and sunshine.
